rationale: The discourse has become more evidence-based, with experts outlining closure-led versus hybrid/non-closure tradeoffs, but the core conflict remains unresolved: labor, state, and family reject closures/forced redundancies while management and investors still insist on substantial structural capacity and cost cuts.
